name: PRAGMA_FOREIGN_KEYS_DEFAULT_OFF
description: PRAGMA foreign_keys defaults to 0 (off) on a new connection
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
PRAGMA foreign_keys;

name: PRAGMA_FOREIGN_KEYS_ON_THEN_READ
description: Setting PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON; reading it back returns 1

name: FK_REFS_PK_HAPPY
description: FK referencing PRIMARY KEY succeeds when parent row exists

name: FK_REFS_UNIQUE_HAPPY
description: FK referencing a UNIQUE column succeeds when parent row exists

name: FK_INSERT_VIOLATION_REJECTED
description: Negative: inserting child with no matching parent row is rejected

name: FK_UPDATE_VIOLATION_REJECTED
description: Negative: updating child to a non-existent parent value is rejected

name: FK_DELETE_NO_ACTION_REJECTED
description: ON DELETE NO ACTION (default): deleting referenced parent is rejected

name: FK_DELETE_RESTRICT_REJECTED
description: ON DELETE RESTRICT: deleting referenced parent is rejected

name: FK_DELETE_CASCADE_REMOVES_CHILD
description: ON DELETE CASCADE: deleting parent also removes child rows

name: FK_DELETE_SET_NULL_NULLIFIES_CHILD
description: ON DELETE SET NULL: child pid becomes NULL when parent is deleted

name: FK_DELETE_SET_DEFAULT_FALLS_BACK
description: ON DELETE SET DEFAULT: child pid is reset to column DEFAULT (which must exist)

name: FK_UPDATE_NO_ACTION_REJECTED
description: ON UPDATE NO ACTION (default): updating parent PK breaks the FK link

name: FK_UPDATE_RESTRICT_REJECTED
description: ON UPDATE RESTRICT: updating referenced parent PK is rejected

name: FK_UPDATE_CASCADE_REWRITES_CHILD
description: ON UPDATE CASCADE: child pid is rewritten to follow the new parent PK

name: FK_UPDATE_SET_NULL_NULLIFIES_CHILD
description: ON UPDATE SET NULL: child pid becomes NULL when parent PK changes

name: FK_UPDATE_SET_DEFAULT_FALLS_BACK
description: ON UPDATE SET DEFAULT: child pid resets to declared DEFAULT

name: FK_DEFERRED_PASSES_INSIDE_TXN
description: DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED: child can reference future parent inside txn

name: FK_DEFERRED_FAILS_AT_COMMIT
description: DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED: violation surfaces at COMMIT when unresolved

name: PRAGMA_DEFER_FOREIGN_KEYS_FOR_TXN
description: PRAGMA defer_foreign_keys=1 defers all FK checks for the current transaction

name: PRAGMA_FOREIGN_KEY_LIST_BASIC
description: PRAGMA foreign_key_list emits one row per FK column with action and match info

name: PRAGMA_FOREIGN_KEY_CHECK_ORPHAN
description: PRAGMA foreign_key_check lists orphan rows after FK enforcement was off

name: FK_COMPOSITE_HAPPY_AND_LIST
description: Composite (multi-column) FK works and is enumerated by foreign_key_list

name: FK_COMPOSITE_VIOLATION_REJECTED
description: Negative: composite FK with one column not matching the parent row is rejected

name: FK_SELF_REFERENTIAL_CASCADE
description: Self-referential FK with ON DELETE CASCADE deletes the whole subtree
